preset.label: ACE-Step 1.5 Text to Music
preset.source: ComfyUI-AIWorkflowMenu audio/ace_step_15_text_to_music.json (converted to API format with the ComfyUI 1.59.10 frontend)
preset.description: Song from style tags + lyrics. Needs the ACE-Step 1.5 model files (not installed).

lyrics.label: Lyrics
lyrics.info: The words to sing. Put [instrumental] for no vocals. Section markers such as [verse] and [chorus] on their own lines help structure the song.

seconds.label: Length
seconds.info: Length of the song in seconds. Longer takes longer to make.

bpm.label: BPM
bpm.info: Tempo in beats per minute. 120 is a typical pop tempo; lower is slower.

key.label: Key
key.info: The musical key. Auto uses a key named in the style tags ("... in A minor") if there is one, otherwise picks one from the seed (same seed, same key).

time.label: Time
time.info: Beats per bar: 4 suits most pop and rock, 3 a waltz, 6 a lilting feel, 2 a march.

language.label: Language
language.info: The language the lyrics are written in, so the words are sung with the right pronunciation.

tagCfg.label: Tag adherence
tagCfg.info: How strongly the style tags steer the song. Higher follows the tags more closely; too high can sound forced.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.info: How much randomness goes in. Lower is more predictable; higher is more varied.

steps.label: Steps
steps.info: How many refinement passes. This preset uses the ACE-Step 1.5 turbo model, set up for 8 steps.

vram.basis: weights: ~4.8 GB turbo DiT + 0.6/1.7B Qwen encoders + VAE (ACE-Step 1.5 docs: runs on <8 GB)

info.prompt: Describe the music: genre, instruments, mood, vocals and tempo, as a sentence or comma-separated tags ("lo-fi hip hop, mellow piano, female vocals").

inputs.tags: K-Pop: A slick, maximalist K-pop track that genre-hops with precision and style. The production shifts seamlessly between sections—a hard-hitting trap-influenced verse with rapid-fire rapping, a softer R&B pre-chorus with breathy vocals and lush harmonies, then an explosive, synth-driven pop chorus with an ear worm hook.
